title: Fix Sketchpad Build Tests Configs Desktop
description: Fix the sketchpad build, tests, configs, and desktop integration. The build is broken because loadAppConfigs() references undefined variables (homeConfig, kitConfig, designConfig, docsConfig, feedbackConfig, qualityConfig, typeConfig). These app configs were never defined as variables but are used in loadAppConfigs and exported from index.ts. Need to either define them properly or fix the registration mechanism. Also need to fix all downstream consumers (index.tsx, sites/play/index.tsx, vscode/webview.tsx, desktop/renderer.tsx).
summary: Restored sketchpad runtime after the consolidation fallout by fixing stale app-store factory calls, exposing syncDoc through the store chain, renaming the compose-specific Diagram export to avoid shadowing the generic Diagram, implementing CollaborativeKitStore file/blob URL resolution for imported kits, correcting Playwright helpers/assertions, removing temporary debug instrumentation, and validating with a full sketchpad Playwright run (6 passed) plus a successful @semio-tech/compose-sketchpad build.
